title: Review execution telemetry record (Issue #182)
description: Observational, never-decision-affecting record of what one review inspected and executed. Canonical prose: review-execution-telemetry-model.md. This schema is the single source of truth for the record's shape; do not restate its fields elsewhere.

review_id.description: Opaque identifier for the review run this record describes. Carries no PII, no repository name/URL, no author identity.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the record was assembled at.

stages_completed.description: Every review pass that reached its own defined stop condition during this run, in the fixed catalog below. Absence of a stage name means that stage did not run/complete for this review -- never inferred from other fields.

files_inspected.description: Every file path actually read/inspected during the review. null when this stage/signal was not tracked for the run (unavailable state); an empty array means the stage ran and inspected zero files.

symbols_expanded_count.description: Count of bounded-context symbol expansions (review-scope.md's caller/callee ladder). null when not tracked for the run.

repository_intelligence_expansions.description: Per-trigger expansion counts from repository-expansion.md's fixed trigger catalog. null when repository-expansion did not run for this review (its stage is absent from stages_completed). When present, an individual trigger count is null only if that trigger never fires as a concept for the run's language/ecosystem -- 0 means the trigger was evaluated and did not fire.

runtime_validations.description: Every runtime-validation.md execution attempted during the review. null when runtime validation was never applicable/attempted for this review (its stage is absent from stages_completed); an empty array means the stage ran and attempted zero executions.

partitions.description: large-pr-partitioning.md usage. null when partitioning did not activate for this review (a diff under its size threshold, or its stage absent from stages_completed).

stage_timing_ms.description: Deterministic per-stage duration in milliseconds, where the runtime can measure it. null at the record level when no stage timing was captured at all. A present object may still map an individual stage name to null when that specific stage's timing could not be measured, distinct from the stage being entirely absent from stages_completed.
